meaning: Review routing only. Existing requirement/finding IDs and source approval remain authoritative; no automatic numeric criteria or closure.

obligations.statement: Reconcile current I32 supplement, original criteria and explicit source effectivity; separate prior digital closure, approval, physical qualification and new assurance coverage.
Verify exact ASC/F1 cavity, mating view, single full-current return, fused switched feed, sensor return, polarity and populated/empty cavities across applicable vehicle variants and fault states.

Bound current selected input protection, U101 ordering pedigree, reverse battery, transient/fault and partial-power behavior against exact primary sources; preserve limited model and physical acceptance claims.

Bound 5 V/3.3 V startup, load release, reverse discharge, current limits and reset/enable timing across sourced corners without relaxing the retained small margins or substituting ideal silicon behavior.

Independently verify current CAN transceiver pin/package mapping, bus loading, protection, optional termination population and listen-only/no-transmit behavior including boot, fault, reset, stale configuration and bus-off states.

Verify actual PA1616D pin-one/orientation, local-install acceptance, TX/RX/PPS, supplies/backup, antenna interface and source-bound 115200/10 Hz firmware assumptions; initial Rev A mappings are not authority.

Bound exact Honeywell ratiometric sensor excitation, dedicated return, gain/offset/filter/ADC acquisition and calibration across open/short/overvoltage/partial-power states; do not treat fault recovery or virtual BLE oil frames as permission to transmit vehicle CAN.

Bind only the effective 160 MHz firmware, real GPIO mapping, sample/time budgets, watchdog/reset, BLE/RaceChrono framing and data-age/loss behavior; distinguish host checks, compile and on-target results.

Inspect actual multilayer forward/return paths, reference discontinuities, switching and RF/analog coupling, exposed-pad net isolation and current/thermal assumptions; unsupported native extraction remains blocked.

Resolve current C05/W02/T03 effectivity, exact envelopes/stack/tolerances/cable restraint and thermal interfaces; preserve I25 budget and device/local-air limits, including Adafruit 851, with physical loss/contact correlation open.

Reconcile all 177 fitted, 175 factory, two local and three DNP references; preserve exact 13 frozen bindings, package/pad identities and only documented supplier aliases. Historical stock/preorder records are not present availability.

Verify source-bound four-layer stack, copper/dielectric/plating/finish/stencil, all 49 special vias, native CPL origin/angle/side and manual-wave/local process requirements with explicit supplier acceptance; never apply Z1 rules.

Check maintained candidate CAD and procurement registry to generated sourced-CAD/package bindings without executing generators on canonical inputs; preserve historical reports and exact firmware/source effectivity.

Account for every native instance, variant, interface state and required method; retain exact-source gaps, unsupported KiCad 9 coverage, candidate mappings, reviewer isolation, held-out and supplier/physical/vehicle acceptance states.
